summary: Size: keep as one (The delivery is one installable read-only board: MCP transport, derivation, panel, drill-down and cache share one contract and UI. Slicing would ship a panel that cannot show status or tickets, so it stays one feature.)

state.request: Build a BB plugin called Factory Bots that shows the agents of an Empirical Factory as a live read-only board: header with factory health, one card per bot from factory_status with status dot and owned column, click-through to tickets, ticket detail with factory_ticket fields and factory_transcript, refresh every 5s with transcript refetch only when stage or conversation changed. Data only through the Factory MCP server (factory_status, factory_tickets, factory_ticket, factory_tasks, factory_transcript); handle factory-not-running and no-tickets as normal states.
state.message: Wrote the Factory Bots contract with board, status derivation, drill-down, transcript cache, read-only MCP, and normal offline/empty criteria plus the added board capability delta.
